name: React
summary: A JavaScript library for building web and native user interfaces with declarative, component-based code.
description: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces: declarative views, encapsulated components that manage their own state, and a learn-once-write-anywhere model that makes no assumptions about the rest of your stack. Used for both web and native user interfaces; installable from npm and documented at react.dev.
contains: JavaScript library for web and native user interfaces
npm package 'react'; docs and examples at react.dev
